narrative.text: Figure 8.1: AHP decision hierarchy. A top box 'Goal: Rank m alternatives considering n criteria' connects by lines to Criterion 1, 2, 3, ..., n, and every criterion connects to every one of Alternative 1, 2, ..., m.

narrative.text: Figure 8.2(a): SuperDecisions main window (AHP.sdmod) showing three cluster windows linked top to bottom by arrows: L1-Goal (Goal_Node), L2-Criteria (C1, C2, C3) and L3-Alternatives (A1, A2, A3, A4).

narrative.text: Figure 8.3: ANP network. The Goal box points to Criterion 1, 2 and 3; dash-dotted two-headed arrows link the criteria to each other; solid arrows link the criteria and Alternative 1 and 2, some one-way from Criterion 1 and others two-headed.
